description: HVR Hub 6.x workspace — auto-discovers every channel + replicated table on a standalone HVR Hub server and emits one Dagster asset per (channel × target-location × table). Full Fivetran-shape: canonical `workspace:` block (HvrHubResource), `channel_selector:` filter, `translation:` callable hook, `polling_sensor` opt-in, StateBackedComponent (discovery cached to disk; refresh via `dg utils refresh-defs-state`), `action:` field for `noop` (default; HVR CDC is continuous) OR `refresh` (materialize triggers `POST /channels/{c}/refresh` + polls, Fivetran-style). Optional per-asset check `integrate_lag_within_sla` for freshness SLA enforcement. Complements — does NOT overlap — the official dagster-fivetran package, which only reaches Fivetran-platform-managed HVR (Enterprise tier). This component is for customers running standalone HVR Hub on their own hardware.

inputs.description: No upstream inputs — reads live Hub definition + jobs via REST.

outputs.description: One Dagster asset per (channel × target_loc × table). External asset when action=noop (default); materializable asset that triggers channel refresh when action=refresh.

workspace.label: Workspace
workspace.description: HVR Hub connection as an HvrHubResource: `{hub_url, hub_name, username, password, api_version?, verify_ssl?}`. Secrets typically arrive via `{{ env.XXX }}` Jinja templating in defs.yaml. Mirrors the `workspace:` shape used by dagster-fivetran / dagster-databricks / dagster-powerbi.

translation.label: Translation
translation.description: Python callable path resolved via Dagster's TranslationFn — customizes per-asset AssetSpec (key rename, extra tags/metadata, group override). Signature: `def fn(props: HvrObjectProps) -> AssetSpec`. Same convention as dagster-fivetran.

channel_selector.label: Channel Selector
channel_selector.description: Include/exclude filter for channel names: `{by_name?, by_pattern?, exclude_by_name?, exclude_by_pattern?}`. Globs (fnmatch) supported in the `*_by_pattern` variants. Exclusion always wins. Absent = all channels. Mirrors FivetranWorkspace connector_selector.

asset_key_prefix.label: Asset Key Prefix
asset_key_prefix.description: Prefix parts. Default `['hvr', <hub_name>]`. Every asset gets `[<prefix>..., <channel>, <target_loc>, <table>]`.

action.label: Action
action.description: What each asset does on materialize. `noop` — external assets, HVR CDC is continuous. `refresh` — POST /channels/{c}/refresh and poll to completion (Fivetran-style trigger pattern).

wait_for_completion.label: Wait For Completion
wait_for_completion.description: When action=refresh, poll until the refresh completes.

timeout_seconds.label: Timeout Seconds
timeout_seconds.description: Give up waiting after this many seconds (asset materialization fails).

polling_sensor.label: Polling Sensor
polling_sensor.description: Emit a sensor `{hub_name}_hvr_observer` polling `GET /jobs?fetch=latency` and emitting AssetObservation events with integrate-lag metadata per asset.

freshness_lag_threshold_seconds.label: Freshness Lag Threshold Seconds
freshness_lag_threshold_seconds.description: If set, emit an asset check `integrate_lag_within_sla` per asset — passes when the most recent `integrate_lag_seconds` observation ≤ threshold.

defs_state.label: Defs State
defs_state.description: State backend for cached workspace discovery. Local filesystem by default; override per-deploy for Dagster Cloud.
